caption: The drawing consists of abstract, symmetrical shapes arranged in a pattern on a light beige background. The primary colors used in the design are dark brown, reddish-brown, and black, with the shapes predominantly resembling stylized foliage, flowers, and leaves. The composition is centered, with two large mirror-image clusters extending from the middle toward the upper left and right corners. Smaller curved elements are distributed below these large clusters, and a band of repeating arched forms, along with a horizontal stripe of alternating dark and reddish-brown rectangles, runs near the bottom edge of the drawing. The background is filled with a uniform beige shading, while the interior shapes are filled with solid colors and some hatching. The overall shape of the entire artwork is rectangular, with equal space left as a margin on all sides.
title: Free Hand Wall Decoration
